summary: The first version of the PIM Manager toolkit, with a visual editor for your delegation model and the PIM Activator.

new.title: See and edit your delegation model
new.text: PIM Manager shows your delegation model as a graph or grid, and shows every difference before you commit.

new.title: PIM Activator for bulk activation
new.text: An Edge extension lets you activate several PIM for Groups memberships at once.

new.title: One-step engine setup
new.text: The engine's app registration is set up in one step.

new.title: Safer new accounts
new.text: Each new account gets its own random password, with an optional Temporary Access Pass, and WhatIf mode is reliable.
new.action: Grant the engine identity the permission to manage user authentication methods, and re-save your admin definitions to use Temporary Access Passes.
